title: Work after leaving Celestin
summary: She mostly taught, then played at the Dewdrop nightclub and with Leary's orchestra before rejoining in 1953.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And who did you play with after you quit Solishten in 35? Would you play in any little spots or what?

I played... I was doing mostly teaching then, but in the 40s I played with Leary's orchestra for about... I think from 49 to 53 when I joined, rejoined the Solishten group. And then from 46 to 49 I was playing at the Dewdrop nightclub.
